It's Saturday, and Monica has the day off.
She is going to meet Pablo at eleven o'clock.
sentences.Monica og Pablo går sammen på norskkurs: Monica and Pablo go to the Norwegian course together and are friends.
sentences.Hun må ta bussen klokka ti over halv ell: She has to take the bus at twenty to eleven.
sentences.Men Monica sover for lenge, og hun komme: But Monica oversleeps, and she misses the bus.
She has to wait a quarter of an hour for the next bus.
sentences.Nå er klokka kvart over elleve, og Pablo: Now it's quarter past eleven, and Pablo is standing there waiting.
sentences.Det er greit, men nå må jeg ha noe å dri: That's all right, but now I need something to drink.
It's so hot, and I'm thirsty.
sentences.Og jeg er både sulten og tørst. Her er e: And I'm both hungry and thirsty. Here's a café.
